text: I think a good teacher should be patient and friendly. Students sometimes don't understand things quickly, so the teacher needs to explain again without getting angry. Also, the teacher must know the subject very well. For me, patience is the most important quality because if students are afraid, they don't want to ask questions, and then they don't learn anything.

tips.en: Cause and result make the reasoning logical.

questions.followUp: Which one is the most important?
questions.question: What qualities should a good teacher have?

text: I think both have advantages. Young teachers usually understand students better because they are closer in age, and they often use modern methods like games and apps. But experienced teachers know many ways to solve problems in class. In my opinion, the best situation is when they work in the same school and share ideas with each other. That way students get the best of both.

tips.en: Contrast shows two sides of the issue, which works well in Part 3.
tips.kk: Қарама-қайшылық сұрақтың екі жағын көрсетеді — Part 3 үшін күшті тәсіл.
tips.ru: Противопоставление показывает две стороны вопроса — это сильный ход для Part 3.
tips.example: But experienced teachers know many ways to solve problems in class

questions.question: Is it better to have a young teacher or an experienced one?

text: No, I don't think so. Teachers have a very difficult job, because they work with many students and also prepare lessons at home, but their salary is quite low. That's why many young people don't want to become teachers. I think the government should increase their salary and give them better conditions. If teachers are happy, they will teach better.

questions.question: Do you think teachers are paid enough in your country?

text: I think teachers will still be needed. Technology can give information, but it can't give emotional support. A child who has a problem needs a real person to talk to. Also, students usually study better when somebody checks their work and motivates them. Maybe the teacher's job will change, and they will use more computers, but they will not disappear.
